preflight_basis: CApplication::CreateApplicationWindow stores this SDL_Window* on CPdxWindow and draws the loading splash with it. Call RVA 0x13cc1d7 targets SDL_CreateWindow. The PdxDetectWindow call at 0x15ed55a is a temporary settings probe and is not patched. Earlier OpenGL activity is outside this result. SDL_GL_SetSwapInterval at 0x13cc1e4 does not run because this wrapper does not return.
